paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia, chapter 2, halakhah 5: Rav Huna said — Bibi bar Guzlon in the name of Rav.

notes.text: The Guggenheimer edition of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5 explicitly writes Rav Huna. The compressed sequence Rav Huna / Bibi bar Guzlon / in the name of Rav does not, by itself, settle how the two named transmitters attach. The wording is retained without supplying a second אמר; this transmission-chain question remains unresolved.

The whole saved named Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia2:5 paragraph, response/he/index2, 882characters, was read against its raw SHA256/selector and actual Hebrew-edition metadata. Its compressed sequence explicitly has full Rav Huna, Bibi bar Guzlon, IN THE NAME OF full Rav. The supplied Huna title can therefore remain Rav locally, and Bibi stays untitled; this does not establish whether Huna directly quotes Bibi, add a second אמר or admit a transmission relationship. Source Guzlon and named vocalized Beivai/Gozlon forms are compared without a new personal/parental identity or spelling harmonization. The opening supplied ב is rendered In; the earlier alphabetic B interpretation stays archived. The three English histories, two original mixed notes, current note and root title/chain corrections remain exact. No whole Shimon ben Shetach story, students/pearl/donkey detail, question, legal rule or religious declaration from the paragraph is imported into the short notice. No printed-glyph or correction-history proof is claimed; no public GET occurred. Only this qualification is appended and p001 stays held without a supplied second verb, note retirement, authority binding or publication.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 266) and the consulted Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5 both give Rav Huna, Bibi bar Guzlon, and “in the name of Rav” in that order. One explicit verb introduces the compressed sequence. Guggenheimer’s English likewise places both names before “in the name of Rav.” The wording leaves the precise relationship between the speakers open.
